summary: EF 公布 Lean Ethereum 的逐个分叉计划：H* 是最后一个不含 lean 特性的分叉，I* 上 leanVM 和 lean transactions，J* 加 lean attestations、DA 采样和 PCS。账户方向，EIP-7851（代码控制的 EOA 委托）同步 EIP-8298 的澄清后准备归档，EIP-8288 修订聚合策略。隐私方向，Kassandra 公开 Tornado Cash 和 Privacy Pools 的密钥派生方案，Aztec 钱包 Nulo 上线，ETHBEAT 推出 CROPS 指南。

items.title_en: EIPs PR #12630: EIP-7851 syncs related clarifications from EIP-8298 before archiving
items.note_en: Merged at 22:26. EIP-7851 is "code-controlled EOA delegation" and EIP-8298 is the SETCODEFROM code reuse instruction; the title says the sync happens "before archiving".

items.title: EIPs PR #12628：EIP-8288 只聚合当前可执行的交易
items.note: 15:06 提交。建议聚合者只证明在当前链头可执行的交易，构建者优先选覆盖更多依赖的递归输入。起因是核心开发者担心，内存池里大量低于 base fee 的交易会产生大部分被丢弃的聚合证明。
items.title_en: EIPs PR #12628: EIP-8288 aggregates only currently executable transactions
items.note_en: Opened at 15:06. It recommends that aggregators prove only transactions executable at the current head, and that builders prefer recursive inputs that cover more dependencies. The trigger was core developer concern that the many mempool transactions below the base fee would produce aggregate proofs that are mostly thrown away.

summary_en: The EF laid out Lean Ethereum fork by fork: H* is the last fork without lean features, I* brings leanVM and lean transactions, and J* adds lean attestations, DA sampling and PCS. On accounts, EIP-7851 (code-controlled EOA delegation) synced a clarification from EIP-8298 ahead of being archived, and EIP-8288 revised its aggregation policy. On privacy, Kassandra published the key derivation scheme for Tornado Cash and Privacy Pools, the Aztec wallet Nulo launched, and ETHBEAT released its CROPS guide.
